[EN] When the prions ran us out of Thunder Hold, Jabel didn't make it out. If Elinu is merciful, he's hiding out in the ruins, waiting for rescue. If not...

I can't think about that now. I just need someone to find him.
[ES] Cuando los prions nos expulsaron de Thunder Hold, Jabel no logró escapar. Si Elinu es clemente, estará escondido en las ruinas esperando rescate. Si no...

No puedo pensar en eso ahora. Solo necesito que alguien lo encuentre.

[EN] (Jabel is dead. His hands clutch a book close to his chest.)Look at the book.
[ES] (Jabel está muerto. Sus manos sostienen un libro cerca de su pecho.)Look at the book.

[EN] (It's written in a language you don't recognize.)
[ES] (Está escrito en un idioma que no reconoces.)

[EN] If Jabel died for this, it had better be important.

See if Jerad can translate it—he reads a dozen languages, at least.
[ES] Si Jabel murió por esto, más vale que sea importante.

Comprueba si Jerad puede traducirlo; lee al menos una docena de idiomas.

[EN] This is the book you found on Jabel's corpse?

This was definitely written by a prion. Give me a moment...
[ES] ¿Este es el libro que encontré en el cadáver de Jabel?

Definitivamente fue escrito por un prion. Dame un momento...
